title: Remember the Theme
prompt:
A `storage` object is provided that works like localStorage (setItem/getItem/removeItem).

1. Write `saveSettings(settings)` that stores the settings object as JSON under the key "settings".
2. Write `loadSettings()` that reads the key and RETURNS the parsed object — or the default { theme: "light" } when nothing is stored.
3. Save { theme: "dark", fontSize: 16 }, then load it and log the theme — should print dark.

tests.name: empty storage returns the default
tests.hint: const raw = storage.getItem("settings"); if (!raw) return { theme: "light" }; return JSON.parse(raw);

tests.name: save then load round-trips the object
values are stored as JSON strings
tests.hint: storage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(settings)); — storage only holds strings.
